avasettle-api-key.name: x-avasettle-api-key
avasettle-api-key.description: Per-client API key issued via POST /v1/admin/clients.

chain-flow-bearer.description: Alternative API key transport using Authorization: Bearer.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives signed webhook events.

webhookSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads for this client.

status.description: Disabled clients are rejected on every API call.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook endpoint. Send null to remove it.

webhookSecret.description: Webhook signing secret. Send null to remove it.

SettlementAsset.description: Stablecoin asset to transfer from the AvaSettle treasury.

externalId.description: Business idempotency key supplied by Chain Flow. Reusing it returns the existing payout instead of creating a duplicate.

amount.description: Human-readable token amount. It is converted to atomic units using the configured token decimals.

asset.description: Stablecoin asset to transfer from the AvaSettle treasury.

beneficiaryAddress.description: EVM address that receives the payout on Avalanche C-Chain.

beneficiaryName.description: Human-readable beneficiary label for audit and support workflows.

chainFlowRequestId.description: Optional Chain Flow internal payout/request identifier.

memo.description: Operational memo stored with the payout record.

metadata.description: Free-form structured metadata from the upstream institutional workflow.

executeImmediately.description: If true, AvaSettle prepares and immediately authorizes/broadcasts the payout in one call.

approvedBy.description: Human or system actor that approved the payout for broadcast.

riskDecisionId.description: Identifier of the risk/compliance decision that approved the payout.

notes.description: Optional authorization notes for audit support.

payoutIds.description: Prepared payout ids to authorize and settle atomically in one SettlementVault batch. All must share the same asset. Max 256 (the vault batch cap).

approvedBy.description: Human or system actor that approved the payout for broadcast.

riskDecisionId.description: Identifier of the risk/compliance decision that approved the payout.

notes.description: Optional authorization notes for audit support.

tcTransaccionExterna.description: Chain Flow external transaction id. Preferred idempotency key for AvaSettle.

tnMonto.description: Chain Flow payout amount. Numbers are normalized to strings.

tnMoneda.description: Chain Flow currency code. 1 maps to USDC and 2 maps to USDT.

externalId.description: Business idempotency key supplied by Chain Flow or the upstream institution.

amount.description: Expected stablecoin amount to be received at the derived deposit address.

chainFlowRequestId.description: Optional Chain Flow internal pay-in request identifier.

collectionMode.description: Collection rail. derived-address issues a unique EOA deposit address. payment-router creates a programmable invoice for PaymentRouter.sol.

routerInvoiceId.description: Optional bytes32 invoice id for PaymentRouter mode. If omitted, AvaSettle hashes externalId.

notes.example: Sweep confirmed pay-in into institutional treasury.

amount.description: Optional amount to sweep. If omitted, AvaSettle sweeps the full ERC-20 balance of the derived deposit address.

note.description: Operator note explaining acceptance of the partial or excess payment.
note.example: Client confirmed partial receipt acceptable for this transaction.

amountAvax.description: AVAX amount to send to the deposit address. Defaults to 0.002 AVAX, which covers one USDC transfer on Avalanche C-Chain.
AVAX amount to send to the deposit address before sweeping. Defaults to 0.002 AVAX.

notes.description: Operator note recorded in the audit trail.

amount.description: Invoice amount in the chosen stablecoin (decimal string).

asset.description: Stablecoin to charge. Defaults to the first enabled asset.

reference.description: Optional human-readable reference shown on the checkout page.

externalId.description: Idempotency key. Bound into the on-chain settlementId (keccak256), so a duplicate returns the existing record.

amount.description: Settlement amount in human units. Stays off the public ledger.

counterparty.description: Counterparty address. Hashed into the commitment; never published.

metadata.description: Non-sensitive context echoed publicly in the on-chain event.
